purpose: Hold draft response shapes to utterances without converting them into scripts.
rule: Every response braid has an avoid-list and must be rendered as optional, context-bound language after review only.

braids.possible_response_shape: Ask gently what home, leaving, or the trip means right now; do not argue; check distress or safety with the care team.
avoid: That means you are dying now.
You are already home; stop saying that.

braids.possible_response_shape: Follow their lead, answer simply within what you know, and invite the care team if they want more detail.
Acknowledge the feeling without rushing to fix it; stay with the person and seek symptom or emotional support if distress is high.
Speak in an ordinary voice if it feels right; quiet presence is also allowed.
Offer love, thanks, apology, forgiveness, or goodbye only if it fits the relationship and does not coerce anyone.
avoid: Say this or you'll regret it forever.

braids.possible_response_shape: Use clear words when safety or understanding requires clarity; preserve personal words when quoting or honoring family language.
